title: Budget visual evidence before it reaches the language model
description: Choose an image workload, input count, detail-patch cap, and application token budget. Watch the global views, detail patches, visual-token groups, and evidence coverage change together.
sourceNote: The arithmetic uses the BLIP-3 paper's 384-pixel patches, one downsized global view, up to 12 detail patches, and 128 Perceiver query tokens per encoded view. Context budgets and evidence thresholds are illustrative application constraints.

workloads.label: Scene understanding
workloads.detail: A 768 x 768 product or room photo where objects are large and global relationships matter most.
workloads.riskWhenCapped: Small labels and distant objects may disappear, but a global view still preserves the broad scene.

workloads.label: Text-rich receipt
workloads.detail: A 768 x 1152 portrait image with small prices, quantities, and totals spread across the page.
workloads.riskWhenCapped: Dropped detail patches can remove digits or detach a value from its label.

workloads.label: Dense dashboard
workloads.detail: A 1536 x 1152 dashboard with legends, small chart marks, filters, and several regions of interest.
workloads.riskWhenCapped: Compression can preserve the chart shape while losing legend text and exact values.

workloads.label: Tall system diagram
workloads.detail: A 1152 x 1536 architecture diagram where arrows and labels must stay attached to the correct nodes.
workloads.riskWhenCapped: Missing patches can break a path or make the model join labels to the wrong component.
